altruvex-site.name: Altruvex.com — a bilingual Next.js studio website
altruvex-site.summary: A bilingual English and Arabic website on Next.js, with native right-to-left layout and a public project cost estimator.
altruvex-site.scope: Studio website · Arabic and English · Next.js
altruvex-site.context: Altruvex’s own website: the first place a prospective client checks how we build, in Arabic and in English.
altruvex-site.problem: In a market where studios compete on price, the site had to show technical quality through what a visitor can open and test, without borrowing credibility it had not yet earned.
altruvex-site.solution: We built a bilingual site on a custom Next.js stack, with right-to-left layout designed in from the start and a public estimator that shows scope and a cost range before the first conversation.

decisions.title: Arabic designed in, not translated on top
decisions.why: Every page exists in both languages, and the layout is written in logical directions, so the Arabic version mirrors as a whole instead of only swapping its words.

decisions.title: Every price read from one schema
decisions.why: The pricing page, the estimator and our internal system read the same pricing schema, so a figure cannot say one thing on one page and another elsewhere.

decisions.title: The estimate is public
decisions.why: A visitor sees scope and a cost range before getting in touch, so the first conversation starts from numbers both sides have already seen.

delivered: The site in Arabic and English
Pricing pages read from the shared schema
A writing section of technical articles
altruvex-site.outcome: The site you are reading: both languages live, and a public estimator, so scope and cost are visible before anyone gets in touch.

art-lighting-store.name: Art Lighting Store — a custom storefront for premium lighting
art-lighting-store.summary: A custom Next.js online store for a premium lighting retailer, in Arabic and English: a catalog by category and high-resolution product images.
art-lighting-store.scope: Online store · Arabic and English · Next.js
art-lighting-store.context: Art Lighting sells premium home lighting — spotlights, light poles and LED fixtures — to customers who judge a product by its finish and its scale.
art-lighting-store.problem: The store had to show finish and scale closely enough to sell premium fixtures online, in Arabic and English.
art-lighting-store.solution: We designed and built a custom Next.js storefront in Arabic and English, with product images served at high resolution and sized for each screen.

decisions.title: Images prepared for close inspection
decisions.why: Finish is what the customer is buying, so product images are served at a resolution that survives zooming, and sized per screen so pages stay quick.

decisions.title: Two full languages, two addresses
decisions.why: Arabic and English each have their own address and direction, so an Arabic visitor reads right to left from the first screen and search engines index each version on its own.

delivered: Catalog by category: spotlights, poles, LED lighting
art-lighting-store.outcome: A live storefront in Arabic and English, with high-resolution product images and a catalog organised by category.

newlight-lighting-store.name: NewLight — a first online store for a lighting brand
newlight-lighting-store.summary: NewLight's first online store: a custom bilingual storefront with a structured checkout, built for every device and installable on a phone.
newlight-lighting-store.scope: First online store · Arabic and English · Next.js
newlight-lighting-store.context: NewLight is a lighting brand that had no online store before this build.
newlight-lighting-store.problem: NewLight needed a store where customers could browse and buy easily online, without the brand losing its premium feel.
newlight-lighting-store.solution: We designed and built a custom online store around how the products look, with a structured checkout and Arabic and English across every device.

decisions.title: Two full languages, two addresses
decisions.why: Arabic and English each have their own address and direction, so an Arabic visitor reads right to left from the first screen and search engines index each version on its own.

decisions.title: Installable on a phone
decisions.why: The store ships with a web app manifest, so a customer can add it to the home screen and open it like an app.

newlight-lighting-store.outcome: NewLight’s first online store, live on custom architecture with bilingual journeys and a structured checkout.

endCta.title: Facing a similar problem?
endCta.body: Same process, same standards. The estimator shows what a similar build costs before any call.
